name: xbrl-ifrs
label: XBRL + IFRS/GAAP Taxonomy
description: SEC-mandated financial reporting standard — public company filings, IFRS/GAAP concepts

table_notes.xbrl_concept: Master registry of all XBRL taxonomy elements (account names/line items) from IFRS, US-GAAP, or custom namespaces.
table_notes.xbrl_taxonomy: One row per taxonomy package (e.g. IFRS 2023, US-GAAP 2024); the filing FK pins which standard was used.
table_notes.xbrl_filing: Top-level filing record per entity/period — the root context for all facts in a submission.
table_notes.xbrl_fact: Core fact table storing individual reported values keyed to a concept, filing, and dimensional context.

xbrl_concept.name: id
xbrl_concept.description: Surrogate key for the concept row

xbrl_concept.name: namespace
xbrl_concept.description: XML namespace URI that owns this concept (e.g. http://xbrl.ifrs.org/taxonomy/2023-03-23)

xbrl_concept.name: local_name
xbrl_concept.description: Local part of the QName identifying this element within its namespace (e.g. Assets, Revenue)

xbrl_concept.name: data_type
xbrl_concept.description: XBRL built-in or custom data type (e.g. monetaryItemType, stringItemType, perShareItemType)

xbrl_concept.name: period_type
xbrl_concept.description: Whether the concept is a point-in-time snapshot (instant) or a flow over a period (duration)

xbrl_concept.name: balance_type
xbrl_concept.description: Normal balance direction for monetary concepts: debit or credit (NULL for non-monetary)

xbrl_concept.name: abstract
xbrl_concept.description: True if this is a structural heading element that cannot carry fact values

xbrl_concept.name: labels
xbrl_concept.description: Multi-language label linkbase entries; keys are lang codes, values are label role maps (e.g. {"en": {"label": "Total Assets"}})

xbrl_concept.name: documentation
xbrl_concept.description: Normative definition from the taxonomy’s documentation linkbase

xbrl_taxonomy.name: id
xbrl_taxonomy.description: Surrogate key for the taxonomy package

xbrl_taxonomy.name: namespace
xbrl_taxonomy.description: Primary XML namespace URI for this taxonomy package

xbrl_taxonomy.name: entry_point_url
xbrl_taxonomy.description: URL of the taxonomy entry point schema (.xsd) used to load the full DTS

xbrl_taxonomy.name: standard
xbrl_taxonomy.description: Accounting standard family: IFRS, US-GAAP, UK-GAAP, or custom

xbrl_taxonomy.name: effective_date
xbrl_taxonomy.description: Date from which this taxonomy version is authoritative for filing purposes

xbrl_filing.name: id
xbrl_filing.description: UUID primary key for this filing submission

xbrl_filing.name: entity_lei
xbrl_filing.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI, ISO 17442) of the reporting entity

xbrl_filing.name: entity_name
xbrl_filing.description: Registered legal name of the reporting entity

xbrl_filing.name: report_type
xbrl_filing.description: SEC form type or equivalent (e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, iXBRL annual)

xbrl_filing.name: period_start
xbrl_filing.description: First day of the reporting period covered by this filing

xbrl_filing.name: period_end
xbrl_filing.description: Last day of the reporting period (balance-sheet date for annual reports)

xbrl_filing.name: filing_date
xbrl_filing.description: Date the document was submitted to the regulator (SEC EDGAR, HMRC, ESMA, etc.)

xbrl_filing.name: taxonomy_id
xbrl_filing.description: References xbrl_taxonomy — the taxonomy package used to tag this filing

xbrl_filing.name: currency
xbrl_filing.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the primary reporting currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

xbrl_filing.name: status
xbrl_filing.description: Processing lifecycle state (e.g. submitted, accepted, rejected, superseded)

xbrl_filing.name: submission_url
xbrl_filing.description: Canonical URL of the filing package on the regulator’s portal

xbrl_fact.name: id
xbrl_fact.description: Surrogate key for a single reported fact value

xbrl_fact.name: filing_id
xbrl_fact.description: References xbrl_filing — the submission this fact belongs to

xbrl_fact.name: concept_id
xbrl_fact.description: References xbrl_concept — the taxonomy element (line item) this fact reports

xbrl_fact.name: context_id
xbrl_fact.description: XBRL context identifier from the source document (entity + period + scenario key)

xbrl_fact.name: unit
xbrl_fact.description: ISO 4217 currency or measure unit (e.g. USD, shares, pure) per XBRL units registry

xbrl_fact.name: value_numeric
xbrl_fact.description: Numeric reported value; NULL for text-only facts

xbrl_fact.name: value_text
xbrl_fact.description: Text or HTML string value for narrative and non-numeric facts

xbrl_fact.name: decimals
xbrl_fact.description: XBRL decimals attribute: precision of value_numeric (negative = thousands/millions rounding)

xbrl_fact.name: period_start
xbrl_fact.description: Start of the fact’s period context (NULL for instant-type concepts)

xbrl_fact.name: period_end
xbrl_fact.description: End date or instant date of the fact’s period context

xbrl_fact.name: segment
xbrl_fact.description: Dimensional breakdown for this fact; keys are dimension QNames, values are member QNames (e.g. {"srt:StatementGeographicalAxis": "srt:NorthAmericaMember"})

short_description: SEC-mandated financial reporting standard — public company filings, IFRS/GAAP concepts
long_description: XBRL with IFRS/GAAP taxonomy enables structured financial reporting that regulators can process programmatically. The schema covers the complete XBRL pipeline: taxonomy concept definitions (account names from IFRS/GAAP), filing metadata (entity, period, reporting currency), and individual financial facts with their dimensional context (segment, unit, period type).
when_to_use: Use for financial reporting automation tools, regulatory compliance platforms, audit/analytics systems processing SEC filings, or investor relations portals. SEC mandates XBRL for all public company filers (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K). ESMA requires iXBRL for EU public companies. UK FCA, EBA (banking), EIOPA (insurance), and ESMA (securities) all require XBRL reporting.
